howToPlay: Use Eve’s Egg Shooter to pressure enemies with increasing damage from her three projectiles. Deploy her Super to control areas with hatchlings or use her gadgets to escape danger or heal teammates. Stay mobile on water to outmaneuver opponents.
gears: Equip Reload Speed to maintain consistent damage pressure and Damage to maximize her impact when low on health. Shield or Health are great choices for increasing her survivability in intense skirmishes.
trait: Eve is best suited for tactical players who enjoy controlling the map with area-denial mechanics and fluid movement over water.
